sentences.text: From the window I can see a mountain.
The doctor wanted to see my eye.
Let's go see a film tonight.
I love to hear music.
I could not hear his voice clearly.
I can hear the news on the radio.
I want to know the truth.
It is important to know the address.
To know a language makes work easier.

sentences.target: በጥንቃቄ ማሰብ ከመናገር በፊት ጥሩ ነው።
sentences.text: It is good to think carefully before speaking.
I have started to think about tomorrow.
The teacher taught the students to think.
I love to smell the flower.
To smell smoke can mean danger.

sentences.target: ምግቡን ከመብላት በፊት ማሽተት ጠቃሚ ነው።
sentences.text: It is useful to smell the food before eating.
To fear the dark is common.
The child began to fear dogs.
There is no need to fear snakes.
To sleep on time is healthy.
The baby cried wanting to sleep.
After the trip I want to sleep.
To live in the city is expensive.
It is joyful to live with family.
Everyone wants to live in peace.
Without water a plant can die.
For people to die is natural.
To die from disease is sad.
It can be necessary to kill insects.
The law forbids killing a person.
On a hunt killing an animal is allowed.
It is good to fight for justice.
The children have stopped fighting.
We can fight disease.
To hunt in the forest is dangerous.
My father used to know how to hunt.
Hunting for food is done in some places.
I learned to hit a ball.
There is no need to hit the door hard.
He likes to hit the drum.
Cutting wood is hard work.
Cutting bread with a knife is easy.
I went to the salon to cut hair.
It was necessary to split the wood.
They did not want to split the group.
It is easy to split the bill.
Stabbing meat is done with a fork.
Stabbing the ground is needed for planting.
Learn to stab carefully.
Do not keep scratching the skin.
The cat began to scratch the door.
When it itches, scratching is hard to resist.
They began to dig a hole.
Digging is needed to plant vegetables.
The dog likes to dig to find a bone.
I love to swim in the sea.
The child is learning to swim.
Swimming in a pool is safer.
A bird can fly.
To fly by airplane is fast.
A frog cannot fly.
I want to go to the market.
Walking on foot is healthy.

sentences.target: ከቤት መሄድ ከፀሐይ በፊት ጥሩ ነው።
sentences.text: Leaving home before sunrise is good.
Coming on time is important.
I hoped for my friend to come.
Coming after the trip tired me.
I want to lie on the bed.
The patient must lie down.
Lying on the grass is comfortable.
Please, you can sit here.
I could not find a place to sit on the bus.
Sitting a long time hurts the back.
We wait standing in line.
Standing for a long time is hard.
The students were asked to stand.
It was necessary to turn at the corner.
Turn the page slowly.
It is better to turn left.
Falling from a tree is dangerous.
When it rains, falling is easy.
The toddler nearly fell.
Giving a gift feels joyful.
I could not give an answer.
Giving to the poor is good.
You must hold the baby carefully.
I can hold my bag.
Hold the rope firmly.
Squeezing a lemon produces juice.
Stop squeezing my hand.
It is necessary to squeeze the tube.
Stop rubbing my eye.
Rubbing wood makes it smooth.
Rubbing ointment softens the skin.

sentences.target: እጅ ማጠብ ከምግብ በፊት ጥሩ ነው።
sentences.text: Washing hands before food is good.
I must wash clothes today.
Washing a car needs water.
Wipe the table after dinner.
Wiping tears with a tissue is easy.
The student was asked to wipe the board.
I could not pull the door.
Pulling the rope needs force.
Pulling the box is heavy.
Just pushing the door is enough.
He helped me push the cart.
Pushing the button turns on the machine.
Let's play by throwing a ball.
Throwing trash is forbidden.
Throwing stones is dangerous.
I learned to tie shoes.
Tie the rope tightly.
Tying a gift with ribbon is beautiful.
My mother knows how to sew clothes.
Sewing a button is easy.
Sewing by machine is fast.
Count the money before paying.
I could not count the stars.
The teacher began to count the students.
It is good to say the truth.
I am learning to speak in Amharic.
It is necessary to speak slowly.
I love to sing at church.
The children began to sing.
Singing with music is easy.
Children love to play outside.
Let's go play football.
Stop playing with the cat.
Floating on water is easy.
A boat can float.
A leaf can be seen floating on the river.
Water begins to flow from the mountain.
The river's flow is toward the sea.
It is good when blood stops flowing.
Water can freeze in winter.
Freezing meat is good for keeping it.

sentences.target: እጆች መቀዝቀዝ በብርድ ሲሆን ከባድ ነው።
sentences.text: When hands freeze in the cold it is hard.
My foot has begun to swell.
Lip swelling can be from allergy.
It is good if the wound stops swelling.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun is very hot today.
Do not sit under the sun.
The moon is full tonight.
The moon shines at night.
The children saw the moon.
A star shines in the sky.
I saw a small star.
I could not count the stars.
We must drink water every day.
I brought clean water from the spring.
Water is needed for cooking.
